description: Use this when someone wants a website for a small local business (restaurant, hairdresser, shop, clinic, tradesperson, association) or a new version of their current website. Builds a free draft and returns a link where the person can view it. Takes 15 to 60 seconds. Give either a short description of the business (what it does, where, what it offers, how to contact it) or the address of its current website, whose texts and photos are reused. No account is needed to build or view the draft. If the person likes it, the website can be kept on palimpalem: hosted there, changed later by chatting, and run with its own domain and e-mail address. Languages: Spanish, German, English.

current_website.description: Address of the business's current website, e.g. example.com. Its texts and photos are reused for the new draft.

description.description: What the business does, where it is, what it offers, contact details. At least one full sentence. Used when no current_website is given.
